khm.text: Bretagard, the realm of the human clans, is attacked by Varragoth and the Skelle, who carry out a horrific massacre and are remembered in the winter season named Bloodsky.
During the Doomskar, Varragoth leaves Immersturm with an army of demons, and Fynn and the clan leaders lead the Bretagard armies against the invaders.
Over the realm, Kaya, Tyvar and Arni ride giant ravens toward Halvar with the Sword of the Realms, while a rift to Karfell spills draugr toward a bridge, until Varragoth knocks them from the sky.
Kaya tosses the Sword to Halvar and kills Varragoth by cutting his throat with an axe, and Halvar completes the ritual that closes the rifts and ends the Doomskar.
